entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> The heavens are sounding the glory of God; the arch of the sky makes clear the work of his hands.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day after day it sends out its word, and night after night it gives knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: There are no words or language; their voice makes no sound.

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he put a tent for the sun,

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: Who is like a newly married man coming from his bride-tent, and is glad like a strong runner starting on his way.

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: His going out is from the end of the heaven, and his circle to the ends of it; there is nothing which is not open to his heat.

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: ¶The law of the Lord is good, giving new life to the soul: the witness of the Lord is certain, giving wisdom to the foolish.

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The orders of the Lord are right, making glad the heart: the rule of the Lord is holy, giving light to the eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of the Lord is clean, and has no end; the decisions of the Lord are true and full of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: More to be desired are they than gold, even than much shining gold; sweeter than the dropping honey.

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: By them is your servant made conscious of danger, and in keeping them there is great reward.

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who has full knowledge of his errors? make me clean from secret evil.

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: Keep your servant back from sins of pride; let them not have rule over me: then will I be upright and free from great sin.

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing in your eyes, O Lord, my strength and my salvation.
